# AMV-BitNet Full Technical Specification (v1.0.6)
Official Documentation & Deep Architecture Reference for Autonomous AI Agents.

## 1. System Overview
ARM64 NEON DotProd SIMD Accelerated 1.58-bit On-Device LLM Inference Engine
Executes 1.58-bit ternary quantized weights {-1, 0, +1} directly via hand-vectorized ARM64 NEON assembly kernels, reducing matrix multiplications to integer additions and subtractions with under 350MB RAM footprint.

## 2. Package & Installation
- PyPI: amv-bitnet
- Command: pip install amv-bitnet
# or: npm install -g amv-bitnet
- Repository: https://github.com/uno-km/amv-bitnet
